Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €6.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months, no Preisgleitklausel.
Here is the background.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We have reviewed your previous order records and acknowledge the price levels from earlier this year.
To support a 24-month contract term, we must apply the AS-14404 index clause, as a fixed price over this period is not feasible.
Under these conditions, we can offer a revised price of €5.60 per unit with 45 days payment terms.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €5.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months, no Preisgleitklausel.
Here is the background.
We note your reference to volumes; please provide the specific volume figures so we can evaluate them.
As previously stated, a 24-month contract requires the AS-14404 index clause, as a fixed price over this duration is not possible.
Building on your second option, we can offer €5.50 per unit with 45 days payment terms, a 24-month contract, and the AS-14404 index clause.
Which volume can you commit to?
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
